==In a world, far, far away....~Ogla==

''In a world, far, far away, there lives a man that loves to edit wikis. To devote himself to the truth, whether apparent, hidden, or implied, maybe imagined. To face the glow of justice and display that justice to the masses. That man is me. My dog is named Chester. You are my life. Hello world. Goodbye missing information.''
